name: Opuntia microdasys
description: Known as the bunny ears cactus, this Mexican prickly pear has soft, velvety pads covered in tiny golden bristle tufts. Handle by the pot.

name: Althea
description: A striking blue-green columnar cactus with bold ribs and dark-tipped spines that grows tall and upright.

name: Opuntia streptacantha
description: A large Mexican prickly pear with broad blue-green pads and long white spines. Bright flowers in summer, followed by edible red-purple fruit.

name: Opuntia
description: A classic prickly pear with flat, paddle-shaped blue-green pads and scattered spines. Blooms yellow to orange in summer.
